cmdst_description: Link a sticker to a personal command shortcut.
cmdst_list_empty: ┃ > You don't have any shortcuts yet.
cmdst_help:
╭〔 💡 𝐇𝐎𝐖 𝐓𝐎 𝐔𝐒𝐄 𝐈𝐓 〕⬣
┃ Reply to a sticker with:
┃ `{{prefix}}cmdst play Tusa`
┃ Then send it to run the command
┃ with those arguments.
╰━━━━━━━━━━━━⬣
cmdst_invalid_name:
╭〔 ⚠️ 𝐈𝐍𝐕𝐀𝐋𝐈𝐃 𝐂𝐎𝐌𝐌𝐀𝐍𝐃 〕⬣
┃ Use only letters, numbers, hyphens,
┃ or underscores.
╰━━━━━━━━━━━━⬣

╭〔 ⚠️ 𝐀𝐂𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍 𝐍𝐎𝐓 𝐀𝐋𝐋𝐎𝐖𝐄𝐃 〕⬣

┃ the registration command.
╰━━━━━━━━━━━━⬣
